title: Library
intro: Texts for wider reading on Billy Budd: the editions, Melville’s sources and naval history, the Somers affair, his reading, and the criticism. Texts in the public domain are held here; the rest link to where they are published. Each entry says under what licence.

items.title: An essay on the legality of impressing seamen

items.note: Anonymous essay on the legal basis of impressing seamen into the navy, catalogued as "[by C. Butler]". Its subject is the law under which Billy is taken from the merchantman Rights-of-Man. Oxford University copy digitised by Google.

items.note: Review in American Literature, vol. 36, no. 1 (March 1964), pp. 76-79, of the Hayford and Sealts edition (1962). JSTOR spells the reviewer 'Lawrence Thompson'; he is the author of Melville's Quarrel with God (1952).

items.title: Review of Billy Budd, Sailor: An Inside Narrative, by Herman Melville
items.author: Charvat, William
items.note: Short review in South Atlantic Quarterly, vol.

items.title: How Shall We Teach the New Billy Budd, Sailor?
items.author: Malbone, Raymond G.
items.note: Two-page note in College English, vol. 27, no. 6 (March 1966), pp. 499-500, on teaching the novella from the new Hayford and Sealts text (1962).

items.title: The Merrill Studies in Billy Budd
items.author: Springer, Haskell S.
items.note: Casebook of reception and criticism (Charles E. Merrill, Columbus, Ohio, 1970; xii, 142 p.), opening with an extract from John Middleton Murry's 'Herman Melville's Silence' (1924), the earliest response to the first printing that it reprints, then John Freeman (1926), E. M. Forster's Aspects of the Novel (1927),…

items.title: Twentieth Century Interpretations of Billy Budd: A Collection of Critical Essays
items.author: Vincent, Howard P.
items.note: Prentice-Hall casebook (Englewood Cliffs, N.J., 1971) of critical essays on the novella, compiled by Howard P. Vincent.

items.title: The Early Lives of Melville: Nineteenth-Century Biographical Sketches and Their Authors
items.author: Sealts, Merton M., Jr.
items.note: Sealts's edition of the nineteenth-century biographical sketches of Melville with accounts of their authors (Madison: University of Wisconsin Press, 1974).

items.title: Billy Budd, Sailor (An Inside Narrative) (Bobbs-Merrill, 1975)
items.author: Melville, Herman; Stern, Milton R.
items.note: Edition "Edited, with an introduction and annotation by Milton R. Stern" (Indianapolis: Bobbs-Merrill, 1975; lx, 184 pages, illustrations; bibliography pp. xlviii-lix).

items.title: Justice Accused: Antislavery and the Judicial Process
items.author: Cover, Robert M.
items.note: Cover's study of antislavery judges who enforced the fugitive slave laws, first published by Yale University Press in 1975.

items.title: In the Time Before Steamships: Billy Budd, the Limits of Politics, and Modernity
items.author: Scorza, Thomas J.
items.note: Political-theory reading of the novella (Northern Illinois University Press, DeKalb, 1979; xli, 210 p.). Internet Archive copy, borrowable.

items.title: Melville's Fist: The Execution of "Billy Budd"
items.author: Johnson, Barbara
items.note: Deconstructive reading in Studies in Romanticism, vol.

items.title: Pierre; Israel Potter; The Piazza Tales; The Confidence-Man; Uncollected Prose; Billy Budd, Sailor (Library of America 24)
items.author: Melville, Herman; Hayford, Harrison
items.note: Library of America volume 24 (New York: Literary Classics of the United States, 1984; 1478 pages), with Harrison Hayford named in the catalogue record; it ends with "Billy Budd, Sailor (an inside narrative)".

items.title: The Failure of the Word: The Protagonist as Lawyer in Modern Fiction
items.author: Weisberg, Richard H.
items.note: Weisberg's study of lawyers and legalistic speakers in modern fiction (Yale University Press, 1984), including a reading of Vere as a figure who manipulates the law at Billy's drumhead court.

items.title: Sea Dangers: The Affair of the Somers
items.author: McFarland, Philip James
items.note: A narrative history of the Somers affair, its participants and its aftermath, with a bibliography (pp. 291-296) and index.

items.title: Law and Literature: A Misunderstood Relation
items.author: Posner, Richard A.
items.note: Posner's survey of law in literature and literary approaches to law (Harvard University Press, 1988), which disputes Weisberg's reading of Vere.

items.title: Melville's Reading (revised and enlarged edition, 1988)
items.author: Sealts, Merton M., Jr.
items.note: Sealts's check-list of books owned and borrowed by Melville, revised and enlarged (Columbia: University of South Carolina Press, 1988), which assigns the Sealts numbers used by Melville's Marginalia Online; first published in the Harvard Library Bulletin, 1948-50, and in book form 1966.

items.title: Accepting the Inside Narrator's Challenge: Billy Budd and the "Legalistic" Reader
items.author: Weisberg, Richard H.
items.note: Weisberg's statement of his case against Vere in Cardozo Studies in Law and Literature, vol.

items.title: Billy Budd and the Untold Story of the Law
items.author: Thomas, Brook
items.note: Brook Thomas's contribution to the Billy Budd symposium in Cardozo Studies in Law and Literature, vol.

items.title: Comment on Richard Weisberg's Interpretation of Billy Budd
items.author: Posner, Richard A.
items.note: Richard A. Posner's reply to Weisberg in Cardozo Studies in Law and Literature, vol.

items.title: Epistemology of the Closet
items.author: Sedgwick, Eve Kosofsky
items.note: Sedgwick's study of the modern homo/heterosexual definition, published by the University of California Press, Berkeley, in 1990.

items.title: Reading Billy Budd
items.author: Parker, Hershel
items.note: Book-length reading of the novella (Northwestern University Press, 1990; vi, 190 p.) built on the Hayford-Sealts Genetic Text, following the work's growth from the ballad 'Billy in the Darbies' through the later expansions and placing it in Melville's last years.

items.title: Benjamin Britten, Billy Budd
items.author: Cooke, Mervyn; Reed, Philip
items.note: Cambridge Opera Handbook on Britten's opera by Mervyn Cooke and Philip Reed (Cambridge University Press, 1993; xii, 180 p., with illustrations, music examples and facsimiles).

items.title: Billy Budd as Anti-Homophobic Text
items.author: Phillips, Kathy J.
items.note: Essay in College English, vol. 56, no. 8 (December 1994), pp. 896-910, reading the novella's treatment of desire between men as a critique of homophobia.

items.title: Leviathan: A Journal of Melville Studies
items.author: The Melville Society
items.note: The Melville Society's journal, published three times a year by Johns Hopkins University Press (on Project MUSE from vol.

items.title: The Somers mutiny of 1842
items.author: Goldberg, Angus Ephraim
items.note: PhD thesis, University of St Andrews (supervisor Steve Spackman), on the Somers affair.

items.title: Herman Melville: A Biography, Volume 2, 1851-1891
items.author: Parker, Hershel
items.note: Second volume of Parker's biography (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, 2002; 1,056 pp.), covering 1851 to Melville's death and so the Custom House retirement, the late reading and the composition of Billy Budd, 1886-1891.

items.title: New Essays on Billy Budd
items.author: Yannella, Donald
items.note: Collection in Cambridge's American Novel series, edited by Donald Yannella (Cambridge University Press, 2002; online 2009), with essays by Larry J. Reynolds on labour unrest, Gail Coffler on religion and myth, Robert Milder on 'Old man Melville', and John Wenke, 'Melville's indirection: Billy Budd, the genetic text,…

items.title: The Fluid Text: A Theory of Revision and Editing for Book and Screen
items.author: Bryant, John
items.note: Bryant's theory of revision and editing (University of Michigan Press, 2002; Editorial Theory and Literary Criticism series), worked out on the versions of Typee.

items.title: A Hanging Offense: The Strange Affair of the Warship Somers
items.author: Melton, Buckner F.
items.note: A history of the Somers affair; the holder's summary says it "traces the 1842 mutiny aboard the U.S. brig-of-war Somers" through the executions and Mackenzie's court martial.

items.title: E. M. Forster's Billy Budd and the Collaborative Work of Opera
items.author: Arjomand, Minou
items.note: Article in Theatre Survey, vol. 51, no. 2 (November 2010), pp. 225-245, on how Forster, Crozier and Britten worked together on the libretto.

items.title: Melville Biography: An Inside Narrative
items.author: Parker, Hershel
items.note: Parker on the making of his two-volume biography and on Melville biographical scholarship (Evanston: Northwestern University Press, 2012; xix, 587 p.). Part I includes the chapter "Creating the new Melville log and writing the biography" and one on desiderata and discoveries in archives and databases; the subtitle…

items.title: Sea-changes: Melville - Forster - Britten: The Story of Billy Budd and its Operatic Adaptation
items.author: Rochlitz, Hanna
items.note: Open-access monograph (Universitätsverlag Göttingen, 2012; 594 p.) on Forster's part in adapting the novella for Britten's opera.

items.title: Billy Budd, Sailor and Other Uncompleted Writings
items.author: Melville, Herman; Hayford, Harrison; MacDougall, Alma A.; Sandberg, Robert A.; Tanselle, G. Thomas; Parker, Hershel
items.note: Volume 13 of the Northwestern-Newberry Writings of Herman Melville (Evanston and Chicago: Northwestern University Press and the Newberry Library, 2017; xii, 998 pages), containing Billy Budd, Sailor, Weeds and Wildings, Parthenope, and uncollected prose and poetry, with a historical note by Hershel Parker.

items.title: Essay on the Legal Aspects of Somers Affair and Bibliography
items.author: Howe, David
items.note: A lawyer's essay hosted by the Navy Department Library, carrying the note that it "represents the views of the author" and not those of the Naval Historical Center.

items.title: Melville's Reliquary Reformations
items.author: McGowan, Tony
items.note: Article in Miranda 26 (2022), issue "Melville's Measures", on Melville's use of the "Nelson Archive" in Billy Budd: Southey's Life of Nelson in Melville's annotated 1855 Harper copy (Houghton AC85 M4977 Zz855s, with Elizabeth Shaw Melville's note that it was kept for reference for Billy Budd), William Beatty's…

items.title: Billy Budd, Sailor (Pennyroyal Press, 2024)
items.author: Melville, Herman; Moser, Barry
items.note: Grolier Club exhibit entry for the Pennyroyal Press centenary edition (Northampton, MA, 2024), "Utilizing the Melville Electronic Library reading text" with fourteen woodcuts by Barry Moser; 50 copies printed letterpress by Bradley Hutchinson in Austin, Texas, bound by Jace Graf at Cloverleaf Studio.

items.title: Billy Budd, Sailor (An Inside Narrative) (University of Chicago Press, 2025)
items.author: Melville, Herman; Moser, Barry; Bryant, John; Kelley, Wyn; Ohge, Christopher
items.note: Trade edition with sixteen illustrations by Barry Moser (116 pages) that, in the publisher's words, "adapts the text of the critical edition of the novella prepared for the Melville Electronic Library" by John Bryant, Wyn Kelley and Christopher Ohge.
